recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Reintroducing CareTeam encounter/EpisodeOfCare support or CarePlan activity detail reporting would contradict later published Patient Care decisions; any future change should be a new tracker, and workflow-episodeOfCare source changes belong in the Extension Pack.
issue_request: FHIR-19511 was Published / Persuasive with Modification and asked Patient Care resources to rename context to encounter as 0..1 Reference(Encounter), support the workflow EpisodeOfCare extension for the affected resources, change Procedure.asserter to Procedure.reported[x], add CarePlan.activity.detail.reported[x], and exempt the remaining resources from reported[x].
initial_application: The first part was pre-applied by 9e6a11d5a0bd, which changed the affected Patient Care resource spreadsheets and the workflow extension spreadsheet. The second part was applied by 218ec67c42, which added CarePlan.activity.detail.reported[x] and changed Procedure.asserter to Procedure.reported[x].
additional_context: Later published decisions intentionally changed parts of the original application: FHIR-23029 removed CareTeam.encounter and CareTeam workflow-episodeOfCare support, FHIR-25397 refined AdverseEvent.encounter wording, FHIR-26064 renamed CarePlan.activity.detail to plannedActivityDetail, and FHIR-39101 removed CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityDetail and its children. The workflow-episodeOfCare definition is now maintained in the Extension Pack, where it includes the still-relevant resource contexts and intentionally omits CareTeam. ClinicalImpression source remains present, but it is not listed as an active resource in the current fhir.ini.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Current active source has 0..1 Reference(Encounter) for the affected resources that still carry encounter, Procedure.reported[x] is active with the requested boolean/reference shape, Procedure.asserter is absent, Condition remains exempt with Condition.asserter, CareTeam has no encounter/context after FHIR-23029, and CarePlan has no active activity detail reported[x] after FHIR-39101.
